verdict.rationale: x402's Bazaar auto-lists any seller endpoint using CDP SDK x402 building blocks with no registration form or API call, making it discoverable to 'tens of thousands of agents' via CDP APIs, the Bazaar MCP server, and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, with public discovery APIs/SDK for buyers to search by intent — this is effectively a documented feed/import mechanism for agent discovery. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation that listing actually surfaces a merchant's catalog reliably, and no evidence of rich catalog/product metadata (descriptions, categories) beyond price/network/asset filters.
